resources.string: Allow Screen Lock to display over other apps
Keeps touch blocking active until you unlock it.
Optional protection that closes the notification shade while Screen Lock is active. It does not read screen content.
Perfect when the phone is in little hands: Telegram stays visible and active while touches on the content are absorbed.
Step 2 of 2 · Add Screen Lock to Quick Settings. On Android 13 or later, the system request appears directly.
Step 1 of 2 · Allow Screen Lock to appear over other apps. This permission lets it intercept touches.
The basic lock does not require Accessibility. Accessibility is only optional for advanced shade protection.
Then, during a call, pull down Quick Settings and tap Screen Lock to block touches.
Android will open the screen for apps that can display over other apps. The wording may vary by phone.

1. If Android shows a list, choose “Screen Lock”.

2. Enable “Display over other apps”, “Appear on top”, or the equivalent option.

3. Return to Screen Lock.
Android requires you to enable this permission yourself. Screen Lock only uses it to place a touch surface over the call; it does not read the screen.
This protection is optional. While Screen Lock is active, it uses an Accessibility service limited to System UI to ask Android to close the notification shade as soon as it opens.
The service does not read screen content and does not analyze Telegram. Android lists it under Accessibility because that is where the shade-closing action is available.
In Android settings, find “Screen Lock · Shade protection”, open it, and enable the switch. Then return here.
If the item is disabled and Android shows “Restricted setting”, open App info and look for “Allow restricted settings”. Some Android variants may not offer this option.
Checks GitHub at startup and automatically downloads a newer release. Android will still ask for confirmation before installation.
The update check only uses the public GitHub Releases API. No account, analytics, or tracking.
From the Quick Settings tile you can leave a few seconds to close the shade and position the phone before touches are blocked.
The press must start on the unlock target and remain almost still. A second finger, excessive movement, or releasing cancels the countdown.
At 0–10% the video call remains practically unchanged.
While Screen Lock is active, it asks Android to close notifications and Quick Settings immediately.
Requires optional Accessibility setup. Tap to see what to enable and why.
Shows the unlock target when activated; it then becomes subtle and reappears while pressing.
A small vibration when unlocking starts and completes.
No account and no analysis of screen content. Internet access is only used to check and download official GitHub releases. The local overlay captures touches without reading the screen.

The normal lock remains below critical system windows. Advanced shade protection can ask Android to close notifications and Quick Settings, but Power, emergency UI, and other security surfaces remain under Android control.
Screen Lock · simple, local, no account
Use the system language automatically, or choose a language just for Screen Lock.
